# 劳动价值论是历史性范畴：当代价值危机 / The Labor Theory of Value as a Historical Category: The Contemporary Crisis of Value

> Open preprint by Didgeridoo (pen name), first made public 2026-11-16. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
> Primary DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24270266 · Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24269665 · Second DOI: 10.6084/m9.figshare.35018998.v1 · OSF: https://osf.io/wubs2/
> Status: open preprint, NOT peer reviewed, NOT a journal publication.
> Language of the full text: Chinese (zh-CN), with an English abstract written by the author.
> All public copies use only the pen name Didgeridoo; no real name, email, phone or messaging account appears.

This paper argues that the labour theory of value is a historically specific category grounded in
wage labour, socially necessary labour time and generalised commodity exchange. Under automated
production, variable capital is irreversibly expelled, profit turns into a negative political cost
of maintaining the shell of private property, and commodity society faces a four-fold impossibility
of self-repair. The conclusion is a call for the historical reconfiguration of production relations.
